title: Create Cost Model service skeleton (routing, auth/tenancy middleware, and endpoint scaffolding)
creator: Ethan Park
description:
Goal
Create the initial monorepo service skeleton for the internal Cost Model API so downstream work (schema wiring, telemetry inputs, and Console/Optimize adoption) has a stable, reviewable foundation.

This ticket is intentionally NOT implementing the cost math. It establishes:
- Service scaffolding + deployable binary/container
- Request routing (internal gateway -> service), tenancy/auth middleware, and request bounds
- Endpoint stubs and response envelope conventions
- Baseline observability (metrics, tracing, logs), config plumbing, and CI wiring

Context
We are standardizing cost primitives so Console + Optimize + billing hooks use the same canonical definitions. Early work has been blocked by each team prototyping their own endpoint shapes and auth patterns. This skeleton should lock in the service shape and safety rails before we start filling in computation logic.

Scope / Deliverables
1) New service package in monorepo
- Service name: cost-model-service (internal)
- Build target + docker image + dev runner
- Standard service config (env, region, stage) aligned to platform conventions

2) Routing + auth/tenancy
- Internal-only endpoint exposure (no public edge)
- Service-to-service auth: verify Redwood internal identity token (OIDC) OR mTLS identity, depending on environment
- Enforce org_id + project_id/tenant_id resolution via standard tenancy middleware
- Authorize callers: Console backend + Optimize backend + billing hooks (service principals)
- Reject cross-tenant access; emit audit log fields (caller, org_id, project_id, request_id)

3) Endpoint scaffolding (stubs)
Implement handlers with request/response scaffolding (no cost calculations yet). Target endpoints for v1:
- POST /internal/cost-model/v1/estimate
- POST /internal/cost-model/v1/breakdown
- POST /internal/cost-model/v1/what-if

Minimum behavior:
- Validate payload size and high-level required fields (don’t parse deeply until ENG-4822 lands)
- Return 501 Not Implemented for computation fields, but with stable error shape and request_id
- Support schema_version negotiation header (draft):
  - Request header: X-Redwood-Cost-Schema-Version: 1
  - Response header: X-Redwood-Cost-Schema-Version: 1
  - If unknown version: return 400 with explicit error code COST_SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED

4) Request bounding / safety rails (initial)
- Max request body size (proposed: 256KB)
- Max items per request for batch estimation (proposed: 200)
- Timeouts: server handler timeout 250ms (stubs should be fast); client guidance will be in ENG-4830
- Add placeholders for cache layer hooks (no caching logic required in this ticket)

5) Observability + runbook hooks
- Metrics: request_count, error_count by route + status_code, latency_ms p50/p95
- Structured logs including request_id, caller_service, org_id, schema_version
- Tracing: propagate trace context from caller; create server spans per endpoint
- Dashboard links placeholder (Grafana) and oncall ownership annotation

Non-goals
- Implementing cost computations or breakdown taxonomy (tracked in ENG-4822, ADRs)
- Telemetry ingestion/aggregation pipelines (ENG-4823)
- Client library (ENG-4830)
- Any customer-facing exposure or docs beyond internal engineering notes

Implementation notes
- Use standard Redwood service template (http server + middleware stack)
- Tenancy middleware should use the shared control-plane resolver (same as quotas/billing hooks)
- Prefer consistent error envelope fields:
  - error_code (stable string)
  - message (human readable)
  - request_id
  - retryable (true/false)

Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Service builds in CI and runs locally with a stub config
- [x] Endpoints are reachable behind internal gateway in staging
- [x] AuthN: requests without valid service identity are rejected
- [x] AuthZ: tenancy middleware rejects cross-org access; audit fields are logged
- [x] Request bounds enforced (payload size + item count)
- [x] Standard error shape implemented for validation/auth/version errors
- [x] Metrics + traces emitted and visible in staging
- [x] Security review checklist completed (internal-only, auth, logging)

Testing
- Unit tests: middleware ordering, auth failure modes, version header validation, bounds checks
- Smoke test in staging: curl via internal tooling using Console service principal

Links
- Confluence design spec (draft): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/cost-model-api-v1-design-spec.json
- API guidelines addendum: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/api-standards/cost-model-api-guidelines.json
- Related tickets: ENG-4822 (schema v1), ENG-4823 (telemetry inputs), ENG-4830 (client library)

Rollout plan
- Stage 1: deploy skeleton to staging only, allowlisted callers (console-backend-stg, optimize-backend-stg)
- Stage 2: deploy to prod with endpoints returning 501 but fully authenticated/authorized (safe no-op)
- Stage 3: begin enabling estimate endpoint once schema + computation lands (separate ticket/PR)

Owner
Benji Okafor (Platform Control Plane)

Reviewers (suggested)

- Chloe Martin (Console integration)

comments: 2026-01-07 (Ethan Park): Please keep the routing path internal-only. We should not accidentally make this reachable from public edge. Also align error envelope with existing quota-service errors so Console can reuse parsing.

2026-01-08 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): For auth, in prod we should prefer the standard s2s OIDC token verification. mTLS identity is fine for local/dev. Make sure org_id resolution comes from the tenancy resolver middleware, not caller-provided fields.

2026-01-10 (Rafael Mendes): Add basic RED metrics + tracing now, even if endpoints are 501. Otherwise we’ll be blind during Console integration. Also please annotate the service with oncall=platform-control-plane in the service registry metadata.

2026-01-14 (Benji Okafor): Implemented skeleton using the standard service template. Added middleware stack: request_id -> tracing -> authn -> tenancy -> bounds -> handler. Endpoints return COST_NOT_IMPLEMENTED with request_id. Pushing PR for review.

2026-01-16 (Chloe Martin): Thanks. One request: keep latency overhead minimal since Console may call this on hot paths. Please ensure no synchronous calls to telemetry store are added in this skeleton (even as placeholders).

2026-01-20 (Benji Okafor): Updated to enforce max 256KB and max_items=200 (configurable). Added version header validation and error_code COST_SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED. Added basic Prometheus metrics + structured logs.
2026-01-22 (Ethan Park): Approved. Marking done; follow-ups will land in ENG-4822/4823/4830. Please confirm prod deploy is internal-only + allowlisted.
